E: Nernst potential of one kind of ion: the voltage of the inside relative to the outside at which it stops leaking
c_in: Concentration of the ion inside the cell
c_out: Concentration of the ion outside the cell
d: Diameter of the axon (without its myelin)
p_x: Horizontal component of the heart's dipole, toward the patient's left (equal to lead I)
p_y: Vertical component of the heart's dipole, toward the feet
t: Time; Δt is the delay from electrode A to electrode B
theta: Mean QRS axis: the dipole's average direction during the QRS, from the patient's left toward the feet
v: Speed of the impulse along the axon
v_bare: Speed of the impulse on a bare axon
v_myelinated: Speed of the impulse on a myelinated axon
x: Position along the axon; Δx is the gap from electrode A to electrode B
z: Charge of the ion in units of e: +1 for K⁺ and Na⁺, −1 for Cl⁻
